description: Defines a 'Size' class representing a 2D size with width and height, including methods for validation, rotation, setting values, and clamping. Contains constants for invalid and empty sizes.

classes.name: Size
classes.description: A simple value type representing a two-dimensional size with methods for validation, rotation, and manipulation.

methods.name: Size()
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes size to invalid or default state.

methods.name: Size(T w, T h)
methods.description: Template constructor to initialize size with given width and height, with clamping.

methods.name: getWidth()
methods.description: Returns the width of the size.

methods.name: getHeight()
methods.description: Returns the height of the size.

methods.name: isValid()
methods.description: Checks if size has non-negative width and height.

methods.name: isEmpty()
methods.description: Checks if size is empty (zero width and height).

methods.name: set(Size size)
methods.description: Sets current size to another size.

methods.name: set(T w, T h)
methods.description: Sets size with given width and height.

methods.name: rotate(Rotation rotation)
methods.description: Applies rotation to the size, transposing if rotation is 90 or 270 degrees.

methods.name: makeInvalid()
methods.description: Sets size to invalid size constant.

methods.name: clear()
methods.description: Sets size to empty size constant.

methods.name: clamp<ToType, FromType>(v)
methods.description: Clamps a value from one type to another within range limits.
